## Meaning

This monitor fired because the signal deviated from its own learned baseline by more than the configured number of deviations. It did NOT cross a fixed number, so 'the value looks normal to me' is not a reason to close this.

Query:

```
avg(last_1d):anomalies(sum:azure.usage.cost{__SCOPE__} by {subscription_name}.as_rate(), 'basic', 3, direction='above') >= 1
```

## Impact

Observability or configuration hygiene is degraded. No direct customer impact, but our ability to see or govern the estate is reduced.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-platform-services`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `auto-finops-review` (fully automatic) runs when triggered.

Actions: `attach_cost_breakdown`, `create_servicenow_task`, `notify_finops`.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `cloud-engineering` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `sre`.
3. Priority contract: P4 — next business day; this never pages.
